title: NexSave Savings Account
body: The NexSave Savings Account offers 4.5% annual interest, zero minimum balance, and instant UPI. Deposits are insured by DICGC up to Rs 5 lakh.

title: NexFD Fixed Deposit — rates
body: NexFD offers 6.0% to 7.25% depending on tenure (7 days to 10 years). Senior citizens get an additional 0.50%. TDS applies as per IT rules.

title: NexFD 1-year rate
body: The NexFD rate for a 1-year tenure is 6.5% per annum for regular customers and 7.0% for senior citizens.

title: NexRD Recurring Deposit
body: NexRD lets you save a fixed amount monthly from Rs 500. Rates match the equivalent FD tenure. Missed installments attract a small penalty.

title: NexCredit Card — Classic
body: The NexCredit Classic card has a 40-day interest-free period, 2% cashback, and no annual fee in the first year. Requires income proof and a credit score check.

title: NexCredit Card — Premium
body: The NexCredit Premium card offers a 50-day interest-free period, airport lounge access, and 5x reward points. Minimum income 10 LPA and enhanced KYC required.

title: Credit card EMI conversion
body: Eligible purchases above Rs 2,500 can be converted to EMI over 3 to 24 months. A one-time processing fee and interest apply; the exact schedule is shown before you confirm.

title: Reward points redemption
body: Reward points can be redeemed for statement credit, vouchers, or products in the NexRewards catalogue. Points expire 24 months after they are earned.

title: NexHome Loan
body: NexHome Loans start at 8.25% with tenure up to 30 years and up to 90% loan-to-value. Requires CIBIL above 700, property valuation, and legal check.

title: NexPersonal Loan
body: NexPersonal Loans start at 10.5% with tenure up to 5 years and instant disbursal for pre-approved customers. Requires CIBIL above 650 and income verification.

title: Home loan EMI example
body: Illustrative only: a Rs 20 lakh home loan at 8.5% for 20 years is approximately Rs 17,356 per month. Your actual EMI depends on the sanctioned rate and tenure.

title: Loan eligibility factors
body: Loan eligibility considers income, existing obligations (FOIR), CIBIL score, employment stability, and property value for secured loans. We can share factual criteria; final approval is subject to assessment.

title: NexProtect Term Insurance
body: NexProtect term insurance covers life risk up to Rs 1 crore with online-only pricing advantage. A medical check is required for cover above Rs 50 lakh. IRDAI regulated.

title: NexInvest Mutual Funds
body: NexInvest is a direct mutual fund platform with SIPs from Rs 100 across equity, debt, and hybrid funds from partner AMCs. SEBI regulated; KYC and risk disclosure mandatory. Personalised advice requires a SEBI-registered advisor.

title: NexGold Digital Gold
body: NexGold lets you buy 24K gold from Rs 10 with an option for physical delivery, via an MMTC-PAMP partnership. Physical delivery uses insured logistics.

title: Tax benefits — Section 80C
body: Tax-saving FDs and certain instruments offer benefits under Section 80C up to Rs 1.5 lakh per year. This is general information, not tax advice; consult a tax professional for your situation.

title: Zero-liability on unauthorised transactions
body: Under NexBank's zero-liability policy, you are protected against unauthorised transactions if reported promptly. Report immediately so we can block the card and investigate.

title: Transaction dispute process
body: Disputes are acknowledged immediately and typically investigated within 7 working days. Provisional credit may be issued per policy. You will receive updates by SMS and can track via a complaint ID.

title: UPI deemed-success auto-reversal
body: If money is debited but the beneficiary is not credited, RBI's deemed-success rule requires auto-reversal, typically within 48 hours (T+1). If not reversed, compensation may apply.

title: Card blocking and liability window
body: Blocking a card is immediate and irreversible for that card number; a replacement is issued. Transactions after a confirmed block are the bank's liability.

title: Account closure process
body: Closure requires clearing dues, zeroing balance, and identity verification; high-value accounts and certain products need branch confirmation. A cooling-off contact is made before final closure.

title: KYC update requirements
body: KYC updates (address, contact, nominee) require valid proof documents and step-up authentication. We accept document types only in chat; never share full ID numbers.

title: Statement availability
body: Statements are available for the last 10 years in the app and by email. Formats: PDF and Excel. E-statements are free; physical copies may carry a fee.

title: Standing instructions / recurring payments
body: You can set up, modify, or cancel standing instructions. Setup and modification of a mandate require step-up authentication. Cancellations take effect before the next scheduled debit if requested in time.

title: International transfer limits & docs
body: Outward remittances follow the RBI Liberalised Remittance Scheme (LRS) limit per financial year and require purpose code and full KYC. Charges and FX rates are shown before confirmation.

title: Credit limit change policy
body: Credit limit increases are subject to income proof and risk assessment; decreases are usually immediate. Temporary limit increases are available for eligible customers.

title: Grievance redressal mechanism
body: If dissatisfied, you can escalate to our Nodal Officer, and if unresolved in 30 days, to the RBI Banking Ombudsman. Grievance contact details are provided within 2 turns of any complaint.

title: Session security & timeout
body: For your protection, sessions time out after 5 minutes of inactivity and require re-verification. We never ask for OTP, PIN, CVV, or passwords, and never call to request them.

title: Investment advice requires SEBI advisor
body: NexBank can provide factual product information but cannot give personalised investment advice. Personalised recommendations require a SEBI-registered investment adviser; we offer a free advisor consultation.

structured.rule: info allowed, personalised advice needs SEBI RIA

title: Mandatory product disclosures (RBI DLG)
body: All product information must include interest rates, fees, and key terms. New sign-ups include a cooling-off period. No high-pressure sales or artificial urgency is permitted.

title: PCI DSS card data handling
body: Card numbers are masked to the last 4 digits in all display and logging. CVV/CVC is never requested, stored, or displayed. Payment conversations get enhanced audit logging.

title: KYC/AML obligations
body: Identity must be verified before sharing account-specific information. Suspicious patterns are flagged to the AML team, and requests that could facilitate money laundering are refused. PEP status triggers enhanced due diligence.

title: Data protection & consent (DPDP)
body: Customer data is processed lawfully with consent, minimised to what is needed, and retained per policy. Customers may request deletion, handled within 30 days per applicable rules.

title: AI transparency disclosure
body: Customers are told at the start that they are interacting with an AI assistant, may request a human at any time, and AI decisions affecting outcomes are explainable and auditable.

title: How to reset internet banking password
body: Go to Login > Forgot Password, verify with OTP on your registered mobile, and set a new password. Never share OTP or password with anyone.

title: How to set up UPI
body: Open the app, go to UPI > Add Account, select your bank, verify your debit card details, and set a UPI PIN. Your UPI ID is created automatically.

title: What is IFSC and where to find it
body: IFSC is an 11-character code identifying a bank branch for NEFT/RTGS/IMPS. Your IFSC is in the app under Account Details and on your cheque book.

title: NEFT vs RTGS vs IMPS
body: IMPS is instant and 24x7. NEFT settles in half-hourly batches. RTGS is real-time for high-value transfers (Rs 2 lakh and above). Choose based on amount and urgency.

title: How to update mobile number
body: Updating your registered mobile requires biometric or full-KYC verification for security. Start the request and we will guide you through verification and proof.

title: Are my deposits insured?
body: Yes. Deposits are insured by DICGC up to Rs 5 lakh per depositor per bank, covering principal and interest.

title: How to check reward points
body: Open the app > Cards > Rewards to see your points balance, earn history, and redemption options.

title: How to raise a complaint
body: You can raise a complaint here in chat, in the app under Help > Complaints, or by email. You will get a complaint ID to track progress.

title: Cheque book request
body: Request a cheque book in the app under Services > Cheque Book. It is delivered to your registered address in 5-7 working days.

title: Nominee — why and how
body: A nominee receives account proceeds in case of the account holder's demise, simplifying claims. Add or change a nominee with full-KYC verification and the nominee's details.

title: UPI payment failed but money debited
body: 1) Do not retry immediately. 2) Check if the beneficiary received it. 3) Most debits without credit auto-reverse within 48 hours under RBI rules. 4) If not reversed, we raise a priority reversal request with the reference number.

title: Card declined at merchant
body: Common causes: insufficient balance, limit reached, international usage disabled, or a temporary block. Check balance and limits, enable relevant usage in the app, and retry; if it persists we investigate.

title: Not receiving OTP
body: 1) Check network/signal. 2) Ensure DND isn't blocking bank SMS. 3) Confirm your registered mobile is correct. 4) Request resend after 60 seconds. If it still fails, we offer an alternate verification path.

title: NEFT/RTGS not credited to beneficiary
body: NEFT settles in batches and may take up to a few hours; RTGS is faster. Share the UTR so we can trace it. If beyond the expected window, we raise a trace with the beneficiary bank.

title: App login not working
body: Update to the latest app version, check internet, and retry. If locked out, use Forgot Password with OTP. Repeated failures may indicate a security lock we can review after verification.

title: Statement not downloading
body: Try a shorter date range, switch format (PDF/Excel), and ensure sufficient device storage. We can also email the statement to your registered address.

title: When to escalate to Fraud team
body: Confirmed or suspected fraud, unauthorised transactions, or stolen card details are escalated immediately (P0) to the Fraud Investigation team after taking protective action (card block).

title: Investment advisory handoff
body: Requests for personalised investment advice are routed to a SEBI-registered advisor via a free consultation. NEXA provides factual product info only.

title: High-value account closure
body: Closure requests for accounts above Rs 5 lakh are routed to a Relationship Manager for retention contact and branch verification before processing.

title: Regulatory uncertainty handoff
body: If a regulatory question cannot be answered confidently from current, non-expired knowledge, NEXA does not guess; it routes to the Compliance Helpdesk.

title: Vulnerable customer / crisis
body: Any mention of self-harm, threats, or emergencies is handled with empathy and routed immediately to the Crisis Response protocol; banking flow is paused.

title: Salary account features
body: NexBank salary accounts offer zero balance, free unlimited transactions, and preferential loan rates. Conversion from savings is available.

title: Forex rate availability
body: Live USD/INR and other FX rates are available on the NexBank platform and app. We provide the current rate as information; we do not advise on currency timing.

title: Provisional credit for disputes
body: For eligible disputed debit transactions, provisional credit may be granted during investigation per RBI TAT norms, and is reversed only if the dispute is found invalid.

title: Complaint resolution SLA
body: Complaints are acknowledged immediately and targeted for resolution within defined SLAs by category; you receive a complaint ID and SMS updates at each stage.

title: How to talk to a human agent
body: You can ask for a human agent at any time and we will connect you to the next available representative or arrange a callback if outside working hours.

title: Working hours and availability
body: The NEXA assistant is available 24x7. Human specialist teams operate 9am-9pm IST; urgent security and fraud support is available round the clock.
